scope: Interpretation layer for the two preserved standalone v0.1 checksum manifests. It does not alter either manifest or any DOI-bound byte.
authority_rule: The preserved manifests record release-package byte representations. Git checkout line-ending normalization is not evidence of content corruption when the declared canonicalization reproduces the recorded digest.
claim_boundary: A checksum match establishes byte identity in the declared hash domain only; it is not implementation, conformance, safety, legal, certification, or deployment evidence.

verification.normalization_rule: For crlf_text_bytes only, an LF checkout is transformed to CRLF before hashing. Existing CRLF bytes are hashed unchanged; mixed or bare-CR input is rejected.
